content: अभिनन्द {%a.%} That which delights, encourages, praises <ab>&c.</ab> .{@-न्दः@} .²1 Rejoicing, delighting, joy, delight. <ls>Bṛ. Up. 6. 2. 13</ls>. .²2 Praising, applauding, approving, greeting, congratulating. .²3 Wish, desire. .²4 Encouraging, inciting to action. .²5 Very little happiness (सुखलव). .²6 An epithet of परमात्मन् the Supreme Being. .²7 <ab>N.</ab> of a commentator on the अमरकोश. .²8 <ab>N.</ab> of the author of the योगवासिष्ठसार. .{@-न्दा@} Delight; wish, desire.
